risks.risk: Compatibility risk (fitment to a specific car make/model/year) is unknown.

Photos showing what is included/excluded (complete harness, starter, alternator, turbo/supercharger if any, ECU, sensors).
Proof of working condition: start video or diagnostic/compression test results.
Donor vehicle make/model/year (or VIN) to confirm compatibility.
